He thought that the old manual process was more reliable and allowed him to better control what was going on. He retired one year later and the PC were introduced successfully shortly after. Was he wrong to push back ? At that time, that was what I thought. But now, 40 years later, I don’t think so anymore. I think that that delay gave the proponents of the PC the time to prepare themselves a lot better and is a reason for the success.

I can’t help drawing a parallel with what is going on now. Even though I’m pro AI, I understand why QGIS is stepping back.
